player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} wasa {colour} ({piece}) a cikin wasan Othello. Burinka shine samun karin kayan aikin ka a kan jirgin a ƙarshen wasan. A lokacin da kake juyawa, sanya wani yanki irin wannan da ya kewaye daya ko fiye da kayan abokin adawar ka - a kowane shugabanci (a kwance, a tsaye, ko a layi) - tsakanin sabon yanki da wani na kayan aikin ka. Dukkanin kayan aikin abokin adawar da aka yi wa gefe za a jujjuya su zuwa launi naka. Bayar da motsin ku a cikin tsari '[row, col]'.
